scope: Seven manually written followup clauses after complete reading of three later-only guides, before this followup current-owner capture. Prior project context and existing ledger excerpts are known; not a blind review. Supports four existing later obligations, not a new point denominator.

requirements.requirement: Normal intestinal roles of Notch/Wnt require the named pathway, organism and perturbation; retain any experimentally demonstrated differentiation or renewal consequence.
Normal skin roles require a read source with pathway/cell-type context, rather than treating a cancer pathway as tumour-specific.
Normal bone roles require a read source with pathway/cell-type context, without assuming the same phenotype for every Notch or Wnt inhibitor.
Normal-tissue function can create on-target safety limits; state the experimental or clinical population and do not label every adverse event proven on-target.
Scope low/absent classical HLA-I display to the examined normal human testicular germ-cell populations and assay. Other testicular cells, HLA classes and treatment safety remain separate.
A read experiment or human tissue study must support lower endothelial ICAM-1/VCAM-1 or impaired induction in its named tumour/context; abnormal vessel geometry alone does not measure these proteins.
Low adhesion is a candidate entry barrier supported in defined models, while a sparse or patchy T-cell pattern alone cannot diagnose that mechanism or establish clinical rescue.
